title: Customer Loyalty
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office staff engages in various activities highlighting loyalty, rivalry, and personal relationships. Dwight searches for a hidden artifact related to the Holy Grail, Jim pranks Dwight by sending him on the quest, and the staff discusses loyalty in their relationships and work. Pam faces technical difficulties sharing Cece's recital video, and Jim balances work commitments with family plans. The episode also features pranks, conflicts, and personal revelations among the characters.
